interpretation.operator_vs_sharing: Same-operator single and complete independent4 references remain necessary for any sharing advantage.
interpretation.optimization: Invertible s/delta reparameterization and full-Q/K containment do not imply identical Adam trajectories.
interpretation.prediction_and_cycles: Joint observational findings do not identify mediation; the frozen quality/member gates retain their exact force.

operator_equations.bias_position: Outside both output scales; exact current adapter controls over older inside-bias candidate wording.
operator_equations.delta_zero: Exactly tied for every old r/s/W/b state in real arithmetic.

propositions.ancestry: Known Gram and reversible-Markov algebra, applied to exact source.
propositions.claim: Tied C=UU^T and active C=U diag(exp(gamma)) U^T are symmetric PSD. P=D^-1 C satisfies detailed balance and is similar to a PSD symmetric matrix, so spectrum lies in [0,1].
propositions.scope: One actual positive finite-feature global core conditioned on member/layer/head representations.

propositions.claim: The split contains tied at delta=0 and admits an exact positive nonreversible core and a separate finite negative-mode witness at unchanged rank bound.
propositions.not_asserted: Containment of the complete active-weighted fixed-input family, separation for every graph/feature state, native restricted-value output separation, or complete classifier-function separation.
propositions.scope: Available operator kernel family; strict inclusion relative to tied, existence of admissible projected feature states.
propositions.width512_embedding: One nonconstant coordinate plus 511 finite-bias constant features 1/(2*sqrt(511)).

propositions.claim: Delta gives antisymmetric affinity tangent e_i^T u_j-u_i^T e_j; ordinary s gives symmetric tangent. A saved finite tied-start feature example has nonzero cycle derivative 2*log(3)/35.
propositions.not_asserted: Every split is nonreversible, every delta has nonzero task gradient, or a negative eigenvalue appears for every small split.

propositions.claim: All triangle log cycle residuals vanish iff the normalized core is reversible. Sampling provides possible witnesses without full N-by-N storage; sampled zero residuals do not certify the full property.
propositions.scope: Strictly positive complete core in exact arithmetic.

published_ancestry.adjacent: Saved IA3, QKNorm, feature modulation and efficient ensemble conclusions; placements are not claimed identical.
published_ancestry.closest_method: Polynormer ICLR2024 already uses separate sigmoid Q/K maps in Eq6 and printed algorithm.
published_ancestry.linear_attention: Katharopoulos et al., Transformers are RNNs, ICML2020.

whole_model_boundaries.beta: Layer-by-channel parameter broadcast over nodes; sigmoid transformed for beta=-1. Effective global H_i+beta is node dependent and may be signed.
whole_model_boundaries.global_gate: LN(PV)*(H+beta), followed by learned output linear, ReLU and eval-disabled dropout; no global restart-walk formula.
whole_model_boundaries.local_GAT: No intrinsic positive-Gram/detailed-balance guarantee; local directionality is available.
whole_model_boundaries.local_selected: Unexecuted global diagnostic is not applicable, never zero or forced global.
whole_model_boundaries.multiple_layers_and_pooling: Different reversible kernels need not compose to a reversible kernel; actual changing inputs/gates/nonlinear probability pooling further prevent single-kernel inference.
whole_model_boundaries.normalization: Stateless per-node LayerNorm may have affine learned parameters; signed/nonlinear transformations and evolving kernels do not preserve a whole-model PSD or reversibility restriction.
whole_model_boundaries.values: Native value projection restricts accessible value subspace; distinct kernels can act identically on it.
